The '''Mandalorian enclave''' was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]]<ref name="EnclaveCodex" /> in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> The most recent addition to the [[Sith/Legends|Sith's]] [[Imperial Citadel (Sith Empire)|Citadel]] by the time of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] enclave was constructed to house the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire's]] allies among the Mandalorian [[Soldier/Legends|warrior]] clans conducting business on world. Most unknowing observers considered the enclave to be little more than an embassy, but it was also the target of new warriors seeking to pit themselves in tests of strength against the Mandalorians, often competing in tournaments that frequently ended in [[Death/Legends|death]]. The enclave was also the base of planning operations for the Empire's most trusted among the Mandalorian ranks,<ref name="EnclaveCodex" /> and served as a place for numerous [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] to compete with one another for entry into the [[Great Hunt (competition)|Great Hunt]].<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>
